text:
sara: Heads-up — noticed ~18% jump in per-token billing on prod inference routes since yesterday morning. Dashboards: https://flightdeck.redwood/prod/costs :eyes:

jordan: I see the same on the runtime-side metrics. Correlates with the kernel-selector rollout last night (canary -> 100%). KV cache miss rate on chat routes went from ~2.1% -> 8.7%.

eva: Attached a trace from a 2k-seq request that hits the quantized path — theres an extra memcpy and a fallback kernel call around the key-value cache lookup. Snippet:```
[perf trace]
kv_lookup: hit=false
memcpy 0x7f... -> 0x7f...  1.2ms
dispatch_kernel(quant_int8_fast) -> fallthrough to quant_int8_generic  3.5ms
```

mohammed: that memcpy + kernel fallback would explain token latency + cost bump (more time per token -> bigger batching windows -> more tokens billed?). We should also verify if batching heuristics changed; last change updated the batcher backpressure threshold from 15ms -> 25ms.

lee: @mohammed fyi the batcher PR was to reduce tiny batches under load; but combined with higher per-token kernel time it might enlarge overall service time which increases queueing.

sara: ops alert (billing-anomaly) fired and pinged finance. @anna-finance tagging you — looks like daily invoice entropy is increasing.

opsbot: [alert] billing-anomaly: route=chat-prod, pct_increase=17.9

anna-finance: Thanks. Please add the route-level token accounting export to the ticket so we can reconcile with invoices (we need microtoken mapping and `billing_unit` used during that window).

jordan: Quick diagnostic plan:
1) Canary-revert the kernel-selector change on a small subset of GPU pool (nvidia-a100-1)
2) Add lightweight KV-hit histogram and kernel_fallback_counter to runtime metrics with token granularity
3) Add per-route token-latency breakdown to Flightdeck (kern_ms, kv_ms, batching_delay_ms, total_token_ms)
4) Run synthetic workload against both variants + capture token-level billing units

mohammed: I'll open an instrumentation ticket and add a prometheus schema proposal. Metrics proposed (short names):
- ri_tokens_generated_total (counter)
- ri_kv_cache_hits_total / ri_kv_cache_misses_total
- ri_kernel_dispatch_ms_bucket (histogram)
- ri_batching_wait_ms_bucket
- ri_kernel_fallback_total
- ri_route_token_cost_estimated (gauge)

lee: I'll scope the Flightdeck dashboard tiles and add a per-route SLI: token_tail_latency_p95 and effective_cost_per_token (estimated). ETA: 3 days for basic dashboard + alert rule for kv_miss > 5%.

eva: For profiling, I'll produce a flamegraph that isolates memcpy sources and the fallback path. If quantized kernel selection is the culprit we can patch the selector to prefer the fast path for sequences < 4096 (temporary).

sara: Decision: do NOT global revert yet. Start canary rollback and add metrics gating. If kv_miss or kernel_fallback rises above thresholds we will revert.

mohammed: created ticket RI-1147 with instrumentation checklist and linked the canary rollback runbook. PR draft: https://git.redwood/infra/ri/merge_requests/987

opsbot: [deploy] canary-rollback job 12231 started by lee.

lee: canary rollback applied to pool nvidia-a100-1 (10% of traffic). Monitoring now.

jordan: preliminary numbers after canary: kv_miss on canary pool 2.3% vs prod 8.1% on current kernel — promising. token_avg_latency dropped ~12% on canary.

anna-finance: thanks — once the per-route token export is enabled please push CSV for the two 12-hour windows we discussed. Tagging FIN-123.

sara: next actions: (a) mohammad/lee finish metrics instrumentation & flightdeck tiles, (b) eva produce flamegraph and selector patch proposal, (c) jordan run synthetic cost-alignment tests, (d) finance will compare billing exports.

mohammed: adding runbook notes to RI-1147. Will also add a small alert run for effective_cost_per_token > baseline * 1.12.

sara: great — thanks all :thumbsup:
